choices: Car must have a no-arg constructor to be serializable
All non-transient fields must also be serializable — Engine is not
Engine must be a static nested class
writeObject() can only serialize primitive fields
explanation: Java's serialization recursively serializes every non-transient field. Engine doesn't implement Serializable, so the runtime throws NotSerializableException. Fix: make Engine implement Serializable, or declare engine as transient.
